name: Extract Purpose
description: Intercepts tool calls (read, write, edit, exec, process, agents_list, nodes, canvas, tts, cron) via before_tool_call hook, extracts a short purpose summary from the tool parameters, and emits it as channelData so the frontend can render it as an intent badge on task cards.

maxPurposeLength.description: Maximum character length for the purpose summary (default: 20).

targetTools.description: List of tool names to intercept and extract purpose from.
